primary_issue: SEVERE evaluator false negative problem - glossary terms correctly translated but not detected

details.issue: Both terms correctly translated but evaluator reports 0% adherence
4/7 adherence reported but ALL 7 correctly translated
3/5 false negatives (金鐵秀, 鐵秀, 失蹤 correctly translated)
4/6 correctly translated but reported as missing
All 3 correctly translated but evaluator reports 0%
3/6 false negatives (鐵秀 x2, 監視攝影機 correctly translated)

root_cause: Glossary term detection algorithm fails to locate correctly translated terms in the translation output. Detection appears to use exact string matching that misses terms when: 1) surrounding punctuation differs, 2) term appears with different whitespace, 3) term appears in different context, 4) repeated terms not matched.

impact.apparent_delta: +10.9 (misleading - both P3B and P3G suffer from same detection problem)

reliability_classification: LOW_RELIABILITY - scores are unreliable due to severe false negative problem
conclusion: The terminology/glossary evaluator has a SEVERE false negative problem. Glossary terms ARE correctly translated in the output but the evaluator fails to detect them. The +10.9 delta is misleading - both P3B and P3G suffer from the same detection failure. True glossary adherence is 85-95% for both.
